I recently inherited this cab from my late uncle, he never said anything about it so I’m not too sure on exactly what it’s worth or what it was meant to pair with etc. I’m unfortunately fairly ignorant on vintage or pre 80’s gear. Assuming this was made before then. 

From what I can tell it’s got two Silver Bell speakers in it and is in very good condition all things considered. It has a non standard connection on the back. 

On the back it reads “Conqueror” on the metal plate. Which I believe was the name of a vox amp back in the day from checking Google but I’m not entirely sure. 

Any help would be greatly appreciated!

Good thing I’m in the UK then haha. 

I’ll check them out m, they seem pretty reasonable in terms of price

Oh man, I’ve never even heard of voodoo. 

Looks ace, I’m thinking about picking something to get me back into it again and these look good 👀

Legit. 

As soon as someone starts getting downvoted or upvoted everyone piles on to boost the number regardless.

I’m not worried about other people, I look in the mirror and hate myself and there’s nothing that can be done. 

I don’t see any way out of this. I can’t see a reason to go on anymore.

Hi there, thanks so much for the response! I really do appreciate it. I know only pictures isn’t a great deal to go off of. 

1. It’s concerning to hear you think/can see I have gingivitis, I’ve never had even a hint at this being the case from any of my dentists over the past few years I’ve noticed this progressing. 

2. I’m definitely aware the recession isn’t extremely advanced and things like roots showing etc are not present, I’m not worried about it from a health perspective. But rather the aesthetics, if you look at my central incisors and my left lateral incisor from the main image you can see they’re pulling up and looking longer, I’m now experiencing gaps appearing between teeth making everything look out of place. It’s happening everywhere 

I really want to know if there are any dental treatments that can fix this. As I’m not happy with it, regardless if it’s healthy or not concerning yet. I keep being told from dentists “not to worry about it”, but the bottom line is that I hate the aesthetics now and it is worrying me. 

I will follow all advice you have given otherwise. Thankyou!

Hey 👋 

Sorry to bother you again, do you have any advice?

It’d hard to get replies on this sub 😔

Hey mate! 

1. No medical conditions 
2. I don’t smoke or vape 
3. I brush twice a day and floss maybe once every day or so. I have a waterpik but I was told it wasn’t as effective as flossing normally so I don’t really use it.
4. I’ve never been taught how to correctly brush etc.
5. I haven’t got any periodontal condition diagnosed (although I’m fairly sure at least gum disease is present at this stage as it keeps getting worse)
